description.en: Self-hosted index for dsh-Dfy, installable directly from GitHub.
description.zh: dsh-Dfy 的自托管索引，直接从 GitHub 安装。

description.en: All-in-one companion for the DSH web GUI: balance whale widget with usage and per-turn cost, a 106-clip transparent desktop pet, a QQ message card bridged through SnowLuma, Bilibili dynamics/comments with a fish guard, and local redacted memory. One plugin; data stays on this machine.
description.zh: 一体化的 DSH 桌面伴侣：小鲸鱼余额挂件（含今日已用与每轮消耗）、106 段透明动画桌宠、经 SnowLuma 桥接的 QQ 消息卡、B站动态与评论互动（鱼群保护），以及本机双向脱敏记忆。单个插件，数据只存本机。
